description: Read the work item's current detail, forensics, thread and referenced artifacts (or the plan) named by the event's entity before acting.
Recall intervention_outcome and intervention_next_event for the entity; if the awaited next event has not happened, record a quiet check instead of acting again.
Take one justified, reversible action within the role's granted tools; never release explicit holds, reset budgets, bypass gates or infer success from occupancy.
memory_write intervention_outcome = fix_applied and intervention_next_event (usually work_item_changed); a later event verifies it.
Preserve the park, post the exact question and its owner in the WI thread, then memory_write intervention_outcome = human_required and intervention_next_event = human_reply.
A live owner or a named dependency is making progress: memory_write intervention_outcome = waiting and a named intervention_next_event (never none).
The fault is outside the granted tools: post coordination/status@v1 blocked with the reason, then memory_write intervention_outcome = blocked and the event that would unblock it.
